sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》旗下的每日新闻通讯《Dealbook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today, prosecutors in New York are accusing Jeffrey Epstein of sexually abusing dozens of underage girls and asking them to recruit other underage girls.
sentences.zh: 今天，纽约的检察官指控杰弗里·爱泼斯坦性虐待数十名未成年少女，并要求她们招募其他未成年少女。

sentences.en: Patty Mazze on what happened in a similar case against
sentences.zh: 帕蒂·马泽将讲述十多年前针对

sentences.en: Epstein over a decade ago.
sentences.zh: 爱泼斯坦的一起类似案件中发生了什么。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, July 9th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月9日，星期二。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: I'm Jeff Berman, United States Attorney for the Southern District of New York.
sentences.zh: 我是杰弗里·伯曼，美国纽约南区联邦检察官。

sentences.en: Today, we announce the unsealing of sex trafficking charges against Jeffrey Epstein.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们宣布解封针对杰弗里·爱泼斯坦的性交易指控。

sentences.en: Patty, tell us about what happened in New York on Monday.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂，告诉我们周一在纽约发生了什么。

sentences.en: So on Monday morning, the United States Attorney for the Southern District of New York,
sentences.zh: 周一上午，美国纽约南区联邦检察官，

sentences.en: Jeffrey Berman, holds a press conference where he announces new federal criminal charges against Jeffrey Epstein.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里·伯曼召开新闻发布会，宣布了针对杰弗里·爱泼斯坦的新的联邦刑事指控。

sentences.en: Epstein was taken to the Metropolitan Correctional Center in Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 爱泼斯坦已被带往曼哈顿的大都会惩教中心。

sentences.en: And later today, he will be presented before magistrate judge...
sentences.zh: 今天晚些时候，他将被带到地方法官面前……

sentences.en: Epstein is a former hedge fund manager who made his wealth in Wall Street.
sentences.zh: 爱泼斯坦是一位前对冲基金经理，他在华尔街积累了财富。

sentences.en: He's got a palatial townhouse in the Upper East Side of New
sentences.zh: 他在纽约上东区拥有一栋豪华联排别墅。

sentences.en: York.
sentences.zh: 纽约。

sentences.en: He's got a mansion on Palm Beach Island.
sentences.zh: 他在棕榈滩岛拥有一座豪宅。

sentences.en: He's got property at the United States Virgin Islands.
sentences.zh: 他在美属维尔京群岛拥有房产。

sentences.en: And he is friends with the rich and powerful, including President Trump, former President Bill
sentences.zh: 他是富人和权贵的朋友，包括特朗普总统、前总统比尔·

sentences.en: Clinton, Prince Andrew of York in England.
sentences.zh: 克林顿，以及英国约克公爵安德鲁王子。

sentences.en: Epstein was arrested this past Saturday evening at Teterboro
sentences.zh: 爱泼斯坦于上周六晚上在泰特伯勒

sentences.en: Airport aboard his private jet that had just landed from Paris, France.
sentences.zh: 机场被捕，当时他正乘坐刚从法国巴黎降落的私人飞机。

sentences.en: And what is the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么美国

sentences.en: attorney in New York alleging that Epstein did?
sentences.zh: 纽约检察官指控爱泼斯坦做了什么？

sentences.en: Epstein is charged in a two-count indictment.
sentences.zh: 爱泼斯坦面临两项起诉。

sentences.en: First, conspiracy to commit sex trafficking.
sentences.zh: 第一，共谋进行性交易。

sentences.en: And second, the substantive crime of sex trafficking of underage girls.
sentences.zh: 第二，性交易未成年少女的实质性犯罪。

sentences.en: According to prosecutors, Epstein created this network between 2002 and 2005.
sentences.zh: 据检察官称，爱泼斯坦在2002年至2005年间建立了这个网络。

sentences.en: The victims, all underage girls at the time of the alleged conduct...
sentences.zh: 受害者在涉嫌行为发生时均为未成年少女……

sentences.en: In which he invited girls, underage girls, into his mansion in New York and in Palm Beach.
sentences.zh: 他邀请女孩，未成年少女，到他在纽约和棕榈滩的豪宅中。

sentences.en: And he paid them to give him nude massages.
sentences.zh: 他付钱让她们为他提供裸体按摩。

sentences.en: These massages became increasingly sexual in nature and would typically include one or more sex acts as specified in the indictment.
sentences.zh: 这些按摩的性质变得越来越具有性意味，通常包括起诉书中指明的某种或多种性行为。

sentences.en: Those encounters often ended in masturbation, oral sex, and in at least one case, rape.
sentences.zh: 这些接触通常以手淫、口交告终，至少有一例涉及强奸。

sentences.en: As alleged, Epstein also paid certain victims to recruit additional girls to be similarly abused.
sentences.zh: 据指控，爱泼斯坦还付钱给某些受害者，让她们招募更多女孩遭受同样的虐待。

sentences.en: And he also paid them to recruit more girls that could come to his house, therefore creating this sort of ever-expanding network of sex trafficking.
sentences.zh: 他还付钱让她们招募更多女孩到他家，从而建立起这种不断扩张的性交易网络。

sentences.en: The alleged behavior shocks the conscience.
sentences.zh: 这些涉嫌行为令人发指。

sentences.en: And while the charged conduct is from a number of years ago, it is still profoundly important to the many alleged victims, now young women.
sentences.zh: 虽然被指控的行为发生在多年前，但对于许多现在已是年轻女性的受害者来说，这仍然意义重大。

sentences.en: They deserve their day in court.
sentences.zh: 她们理应在法庭上获得公正。

sentences.en: And we are proud to be standing up for them by bringing this indictment.
sentences.zh: 我们很自豪能通过提起这项诉讼为她们挺身而出。

sentences.en: And the prosecutor said that even though some of these encounters happened a long time ago, that some of this is old, these girls who are now women deserve their day in court.
sentences.zh: 检察官表示，尽管其中一些接触发生在很久以前，有些事情已经过去很久，但这些现在已是成年女性的女孩理应在法庭上获得公正。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So the prosecutor in New York makes a point of saying this alleged behavior dates back years and years, basically to 2002.
sentences.zh: 所以纽约的检察官特别指出，这些涉嫌行为可以追溯到多年前，基本上是从2002年开始的。

sentences.en: So why are we just seeing these charges today?
sentences.zh: 那么为什么我们今天才看到这些指控？

sentences.en: That's the key question, Michael, because what is stunning about this case, when you listen to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这是关键问题，迈克尔。因为当你周一听取美国

sentences.en: attorney in New York on Monday, is that it sounded so familiar to allegations made against Jeffrey Epstein in Florida more than a decade ago.
sentences.zh: 纽约检察官的发言时，这个案件令人震惊之处在于，它听起来与十多年前在佛罗里达州针对杰弗里·爱泼斯坦的指控非常相似。

sentences.en: In that case, the girls in Florida did not get their day in court.
sentences.zh: 在那起案件中，佛罗里达州的女孩们没能获得在法庭上伸张正义的机会。

sentences.en: But the story of how the Florida case against Epstein unraveled is one of the reasons why we are here today talking about this case against him in New York.
sentences.zh: 但佛罗里达州针对爱泼斯坦的案件是如何不了了之的故事，正是我们今天在这里讨论纽约这起案件的原因之一。

sentences.en: So what exactly is the story of what happened in Florida?
sentences.zh: 那么佛罗里达州到底发生了什么故事？

sentences.en: The story begins in 2005, when a girl and her parents go to the police in Palm Beach and tell them that she has been molested by Epstein and paid for it.
sentences.zh: 故事始于2005年，当时一名女孩和她的父母前往棕榈滩警察局，告诉他们她曾被爱泼斯坦猥亵并因此获得报酬。

sentences.en: And the police start investigating.
sentences.zh: 警方开始调查。

sentences.en: And what they find is not just one girl, but many girls with stories about being molested by Epstein.
sentences.zh: 他们发现的不仅仅是一个女孩，而是许多女孩讲述被爱泼斯坦猥亵的故事。

sentences.en: And some girls just lead to more girls.
sentences.zh: 一些女孩又引出了更多的女孩。

sentences.en: And so they wind up with what they think is a very big case on their hands.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们发现自己手中掌握着一个非常大的案件。

sentences.en: They take it to the state attorney, but eventually the police feel like Epstein might not
sentences.zh: 他们将其提交给州检察官，但最终警方觉得爱泼斯坦可能不会

sentences.en: get as harsh of a charge as they would like, given the number of victims that they have seen.
sentences.zh: 得到他们想要的严厉指控，考虑到他们所看到的受害者人数。

sentences.en: And concerned about that, they take the case to the FBI and say, help us, we think there's a big case here.
sentences.zh: 出于这种担忧，他们将案件提交给联邦调查局（FBI），并说，帮帮我们，我们认为这里有一个大案。

sentences.en: And why do the local police have that suspicion that Epstein will not be appropriately charged?
sentences.zh: 为什么当地警方会怀疑爱泼斯坦不会受到适当的指控？

sentences.en: What exactly do they fear?
sentences.zh: 他们到底在担心什么？

sentences.en: They become anxious that either because of Epstein's wealth or name in the community or the fact that he
sentences.zh: 他们开始担心，无论是由于爱泼斯坦的财富、他在社区中的名望，还是他

sentences.en: didn't have a criminal history, that he just might not be charged as strongly as they think he should be charged.
sentences.zh: 没有犯罪记录的事实，他可能不会受到他们认为应该受到的严厉指控。

sentences.en: For example, that instead of some sort of sex abuse charge, he might end up with something like soliciting prostitution that would elicit a less harsh penalty.
sentences.zh: 例如，他可能不会被控性虐待，而是被控招嫖之类的罪名，从而导致较轻的处罚。

sentences.en: And so what does the FBI do when the police bring this case to them?
sentences.zh: 那么当警方将此案提交给FBI时，FBI做了什么？

sentences.en: The FBI starts investigating and finds more victims and victims corroborating the stories that the police had found.
sentences.zh: FBI开始调查，发现了更多的受害者，这些受害者证实了警方发现的故事。

sentences.en: Stories about massages and nude massages and payment for these massages that ended up in various sex acts and a web of recruitment where one girl would be paid by Epstein and
sentences.zh: 关于按摩、裸体按摩以及为这些按摩支付报酬的故事，最终演变成各种性行为，以及一个招募网络，即一个女孩会被爱泼斯坦和

sentences.en: his associates to bring in more girls to his Palm Beach house for these massages.
sentences.zh: 他的同伙付钱，带更多的女孩到他的棕榈滩豪宅进行这些按摩。

sentences.en: And eventually, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 最终，美国

sentences.en: attorney's office in Miami, which at the time was run by a man named Alex Acosta, drafts a 53-page indictment against Epstein.
sentences.zh: 迈阿密检察官办公室（当时由亚历克斯·阿科斯塔领导）起草了一份针对爱泼斯坦的53页起诉书。

sentences.en: And what does this indictment say?
sentences.zh: 这份起诉书说了什么？

sentences.en: The indictment lays out these allegations of sex trafficking against minors and carries a potential punishment of up to life in prison.
sentences.zh: 起诉书列出了这些针对未成年人的性交易指控，最高可判处终身监禁。

sentences.en: It's a serious indictment.
sentences.zh: 这是一份严重的起诉书。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was pretty thorough.
sentences.zh: 是的，非常详尽。

sentences.en: And so what happens?
sentences.zh: 然后发生了什么？

sentences.en: So weeks go by and then months go by.
sentences.zh: 几周过去了，几个月也过去了。

sentences.en: And finally, in 2008, the victims learn that there will be no federal criminal indictment against Epstein.
sentences.zh: 最终，在2008年，受害者得知不会有针对爱泼斯坦的联邦刑事起诉。

sentences.en: Unbeknown to the victims behind the scenes, Epstein and his high-powered defense lawyers had negotiated with federal prosecutors so that they would not charge him in federal court.
sentences.zh: 在受害者不知情的情况下，爱泼斯坦和他势力强大的辩护律师在幕后与联邦检察官进行了谈判，以确保他不会在联邦法院被起诉。

sentences.en: They negotiated what is called a non-prosecution agreement.
sentences.zh: 他们协商达成了一项所谓的“不起诉协议”。

sentences.en: And so in the end, Epstein pleaded guilty to a single count of soliciting prostitution in state court.
sentences.zh: 最终，爱泼斯坦在州法院对一项招嫖罪名认罪。

sentences.en: He had to register as a sex offender.
sentences.zh: 他必须登记为性犯罪者。

sentences.en: He had to pay financial restitution to some of his victiMs.
sentences.zh: 他必须向他的一些受害者支付经济赔偿。

sentences.en: And he got 18 months in county jail in which he could leave six days a week to go to work.
sentences.zh: 他在县监狱服刑18个月，期间每周可以离开六天去工作。

sentences.en: Leave prison six days a week.
sentences.zh: 每周离开监狱六天。

sentences.en: Just kind of walk out of jail and go to work.
sentences.zh: 就像走出监狱去上班一样。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was an extraordinary arrangement.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一项非同寻常的安排。

sentences.en: It raised eyebrows even at the time.
sentences.zh: 即使在当时也引起了人们的质疑。

sentences.en: But the prosecutor said it was how they were going to guarantee that Epstein served some time in jail
sentences.zh: 但检察官表示，这是他们保证爱泼斯坦在监狱服刑

sentences.en: and that he registered as a sex offender, which they viewed as important to help the community around him.
sentences.zh: 并登记为性犯罪者的方式，他们认为这对保护他周围的社区很重要。

sentences.en: So the local police brought this case originally to the FBI because they were worried that the state attorney would be rolled over by Epstein by his wealth,
sentences.zh: 所以当地警方最初将此案提交给FBI，因为他们担心州检察官会被爱泼斯坦的财富、

sentences.en: by all his connections and his fancy lawyers, and that he would get a sweetheart deal.
sentences.zh: 他所有的关系和他那些昂贵的律师所左右，从而让他达成一份甜头协议。

sentences.en: Prosecutors would tell you that they did their best and that meant sending Epstein to jail.
sentences.zh: 检察官会告诉你，他们尽了最大努力，这意味着让爱泼斯坦入狱。

sentences.en: But in the end, he faced a prostitution charge in state court and not a sex trafficking charge in federal court.
sentences.zh: 但最终，他在州法院面临的是招嫖指控，而不是联邦法院的性交易指控。

sentences.en: And that's exactly what the Palm Beach police worried could happen at the start of the case.
sentences.zh: 这正是棕榈滩警方在案件开始时担心会发生的事情。

sentences.en: But with the FBI and the federal prosecutors.
sentences.zh: 但FBI和联邦检察官却这么做了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The victims were not given a chance to speak up against this agreement before it was signed.
sentences.zh: 受害者在协议签署前没有机会对此表示反对。

sentences.en: It was essentially just negotiated between Epstein's attorneys and the prosecution.
sentences.zh: 这本质上只是爱泼斯坦的律师和检方之间的谈判。

sentences.en: And so the victims didn't find out until after the fact and after Epstein had already agreed to the plea deal.
sentences.zh: 所以受害者直到事后，且爱泼斯坦已经同意认罪协议时才发现。

sentences.en: And what's the reaction from the victims who have been cut out of this plea agreement and are now learning that he's going to be facing an unusually light sentence?
sentences.zh: 那些被排除在认罪协议之外，现在得知他将面临异常轻微判决的受害者有什么反应？

sentences.en: The victims are outraged.
sentences.zh: 受害者们感到愤怒。

sentences.en: And as soon as they find out about this non-prosecution deal in 2008, they go to court asking for the agreement to be nullified for them to get their day in court.
sentences.zh: 当她们在2008年得知这项不起诉协议时，她们立即向法院提起诉讼，要求废除该协议，让她们获得在法庭上伸张正义的机会。

sentences.en: And this argument turns into years of legal battles over what was negotiated in secret that the victims did not know about.
sentences.zh: 这一争论演变成了长达数年的法律斗争，围绕着受害者所不知道的秘密谈判内容展开。

sentences.en: And what's going on with Epstein during this time as this battle over the plea agreement is playing out in courts?
sentences.zh: 当这场关于认罪协议的斗争在法庭上进行时，爱泼斯坦在做什么？

sentences.en: Epstein gets out of jail about five months early.
sentences.zh: 爱泼斯坦提前约五个月出狱。

sentences.en: He reportedly has a party to celebrate his return to society.
sentences.zh: 据报道，他举办了一场派对来庆祝他回归社会。

sentences.en: And he has to register as a sex offender.
sentences.zh: 他必须登记为性犯罪者。

sentences.en: But other than that, he basically goes back to his old life.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，他基本上又回到了以前的生活。

sentences.en: He had his lavish lifestyle that he continued traveling between his properties in New York and Palm Beach and the Virgin Islands.
sentences.zh: 他继续过着奢华的生活，往返于他在纽约、棕榈滩和维尔京群岛的房产之间。

sentences.en: And the case kind of receded from public view for years until President Trump asks Alex Acosta,
sentences.zh: 这个案件在公众视野中消失了多年，直到特朗普总统要求亚历克斯·阿科斯塔，

sentences.en: the former top prosecutor in Miami, who reached the secret deal not to indict Epstein with federal charges to be his labor secretary.
sentences.zh: 那位在迈阿密达成秘密协议不对爱泼斯坦进行联邦指控的前最高检察官，担任他的劳工部长。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Senate Committee on Health, Education, Labor and Pensions will please come to order.
sentences.zh: 参议院健康、教育、劳工和养老金委员会现在开会。

sentences.en: This morning we're holding a confirmation hearing on the nomination of Alexander Acosta.
sentences.zh: 今天上午，我们正在就亚历克斯·阿科斯塔的提名举行确认听证会。

sentences.en: Patty, what happens after Acosta is nominated as labor secretary?
sentences.zh: 帕蒂，阿科斯塔被提名为劳工部长后发生了什么？

sentences.en: With the Acosta nomination comes a lot of scrutiny into Acosta's career, especially his time as a prosecutor.
sentences.zh: 随着阿科斯塔的提名，人们对他职业生涯的审查也随之而来，尤其是他担任检察官的那段时间。

sentences.en: And so reporters like myself start looking into the case again.
sentences.zh: 于是像我这样的记者开始重新调查这个案件。

sentences.en: I want to just read this.
sentences.zh: 我想读一下这个。

sentences.en: In 2007, Acosta signed a non-prosecution deal.
sentences.zh: 2007年，阿科斯塔签署了一份不起诉协议。

sentences.en: And in fact, it comes up in Acosta's Senate confirmation hearing for the Labor Department.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这在阿科斯塔劳工部的参议院确认听证会上被提了出来。

sentences.en: What is the reason why a deal of this kind has the specification that it will not be made part of any public record?
sentences.zh: 为什么这种协议会特别规定不将其列入任何公共记录？

sentences.en: Senator, I'll answer your question.
sentences.zh: 参议员，我会回答你的问题。

sentences.en: But if he says, as he had said in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 但如果他像过去所说的那样。

sentences.en: At the end of this case, I received a telephone call from the special agent in charge of the FBI.
sentences.zh: 在这个案件结束时，我接到了FBI负责特工的电话。

sentences.en: That they did the best that they could.
sentences.zh: 说他们已经尽了最大努力。

sentences.en: And he called to just say congratulations.
sentences.zh: 他打电话只是为了表示祝贺。

sentences.en: This was really hard fought and well won.
sentences.zh: 这确实是经过艰苦努力并取得的胜利。

sentences.en: And that the outcome was positive because Epstein went to jail and had to register as a sex offender and that that would help protect the community.
sentences.zh: 结果是积极的，因为爱泼斯坦入狱并必须登记为性犯罪者，这将有助于保护社区。

sentences.en: You are aware that Mr. Epstein served that 13 months.
sentences.zh: 你知道爱泼斯坦服刑了那13个月。

sentences.en: He was allowed out during the day and he had to sleep at a county jail.
sentences.zh: 他白天被允许外出，晚上必须在县监狱睡觉。

sentences.en: But he was basically allowed to move and go around the community and do whatever he wants.
sentences.zh: 但他基本上被允许在社区里走动，做他想做的任何事情。

sentences.en: And then that became a subject of significant criticism.
sentences.zh: 后来这成为了重大批评的对象。

sentences.en: And I am on record condemning that.
sentences.zh: 我已明确记录在案，对此表示谴责。

sentences.en: And I think that was awful.
sentences.zh: 我认为那太糟糕了。

sentences.en: Despite those questions, Acosta gets confirmed by the Senate and becomes the labor secretary, which he still is now.
sentences.zh: 尽管存在这些质疑，阿科斯塔还是获得了参议院的确认，出任劳工部长，至今仍担任此职。

sentences.en: But the Miami Herald, his hometown paper, decides that it's going to dig even deeper into the Epstein case and see what happened.
sentences.zh: 但他的家乡报纸《迈阿密先驱报》决定深入挖掘爱泼斯坦案，一探究竟。

sentences.en: Especially now that not only is Acosta the labor secretary, but that the Me Too movement has happened.
sentences.zh: 尤其是现在，不仅阿科斯塔已是劳工部长，而且“我也是”（Me Too）运动也已经爆发。

sentences.en: And that perhaps these victims, who are now young women, might be willing to talk publicly for the first time.
sentences.zh: 或许这些受害者——如今已是年轻女性——可能愿意首次公开讲述。

sentences.en: And what does the Herald find?
sentences.zh: 《先驱报》发现了什么？

sentences.en: The Herald is reporting that Acosta gave a sweetheart deal to a wealthy man accused of sex crimes, including sexually abusing underage girls.
sentences.zh: 《先驱报》报道称，阿科斯塔与一名被控性犯罪（包括性虐待未成年少女）的富豪达成了“甜心交易”。

sentences.en: The Herald investigation, which was published in late 2018, found a trove of documents showing how the secret non-prosecution agreement was negotiated.
sentences.zh: 《先驱报》于2018年底发表的调查报告中，披露了一批文件，展示了那份秘密不起诉协议是如何达成的。

sentences.en: The paper found that as a U.S.
sentences.zh: 该报发现，作为一名美国

sentences.en: attorney in Florida in 2007, Acosta and another federal prosecutor struck a plea deal with Epstein's legal team.
sentences.zh: 联邦检察官，阿科斯塔于2007年在佛罗里达州与爱泼斯坦的律师团队达成了认罪协议。

sentences.en: And the documents show Epstein's defense lawyers being chummy with prosecutors on a first-name basis, while the victims didn't know anything about what was going on.
sentences.zh: 文件显示，爱泼斯坦的辩护律师与检察官关系亲密，甚至直呼其名，而受害者对这一切一无所知。

sentences.en: I was young.
sentences.zh: 那时我很年轻。

sentences.en: I was scared.
sentences.zh: 我很害怕。

sentences.en: I knew these people were powerful.
sentences.zh: 我知道这些人权势很大。

sentences.en: I didn't know what would happen if I said no.
sentences.zh: 我不知道如果我拒绝会发生什么。

sentences.en: I didn't know what would happen if they reported, if I reported them.
sentences.zh: 我不知道如果我举报他们，会发生什么。

sentences.en: That 16-year-old girl just let it happen.
sentences.zh: 那个16岁的女孩只能任由事情发生。

sentences.en: In addition to that, the Herald finds more victiMs. And victims who are going on the record for the first time now that they're adults.
sentences.zh: 此外，《先驱报》还发现了更多受害者。这些受害者如今已成年，正首次公开站出来作证。

sentences.en: It takes a long time to start the healing process.
sentences.zh: 疗愈过程需要很长时间。

sentences.en: I mean, I will never heal.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我永远无法痊愈。

sentences.en: There are pieces for me that can never be put back together.
sentences.zh: 我生命中有些碎片永远无法拼凑完整了。

sentences.en: And the combination of the behind-the-scenes communications about this agreement and the additional victims and the victims putting a face and details to these allegations starts to build new public pressure for something to be done in the case.
sentences.zh: 幕后关于协议的沟通，加上新增的受害者，以及受害者们为这些指控提供了真实身份和细节，开始形成新的公众压力，要求对此案采取行动。

sentences.en: And it's not long after that Miami Herald report that something else happens.
sentences.zh: 在《迈阿密先驱报》那篇报道发布后不久，又发生了另一件事。

sentences.en: That lawsuit that the victims in Florida had filed seeking to invalidate the secret non-prosecution agreement, a judge finally issues a ruling.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州的受害者曾提起诉讼，寻求废除那份秘密不起诉协议，法官终于做出了裁决。

sentences.en: And he rules in the women's favor.
sentences.zh: 他裁定支持这些女性。

sentences.en: He says the prosecutors made a mistake in not letting them know that this was being negotiated.
sentences.zh: 他说，检察官在谈判过程中未告知受害者，这是一个错误。

sentences.en: And by prosecutors, you mean Alex Acosta, who is now the United States Labor Secretary.
sentences.zh: 你所说的检察官，是指现任美国劳工部长亚历克斯·阿科斯塔吗？

sentences.en: That's correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The judge ruled that Acosta and his office violated the victims' rights by not letting them know about this secret deal that they had negotiated with Epstein.
sentences.zh: 法官裁定，阿科斯塔及其办公室在与爱泼斯坦达成秘密协议时未通知受害者，侵犯了她们的权利。

sentences.en: And that's where everything was until we got to Monday in New York.
sentences.zh: 这就是周一纽约事态发生前的情况。

sentences.en: Is that what led the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这就是导致美国

sentences.en: attorney in New York to bring these charges on Monday?
sentences.zh: 纽约联邦检察官在周一提起这些指控的原因吗？

sentences.en: We don't know exactly.
sentences.zh: 我们并不确切知道。

sentences.en: That case is still pending in Florida.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州的案件仍在审理中。

sentences.en: What we do know is that the prosecutor in New York apparently found a new victim in his jurisdiction.
sentences.zh: 我们所知道的是，纽约的检察官显然在他的司法管辖区内发现了一名新的受害者。

sentences.en: And that seems to be a primary driver in his decision to pursue this case now.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是他决定现在起诉此案的主要驱动力。

sentences.en: And it's possible for him to also draw in some of the allegations from Florida into his case.
sentences.zh: 而且他也有可能将佛罗里达州的一些指控纳入他的案件中。

sentences.en: We know that he went out of his way to say on Monday that the non-prosecution agreement in Florida does not apply to them in New York.
sentences.zh: 我们知道，他在周一特意指出，佛罗里达州的不起诉协议对纽约的案件不适用。

sentences.en: But it is key to note that they have found a victim there.
sentences.zh: 但关键在于，他们确实在那里发现了一名受害者。

sentences.en: And so that gives a new dimension to their findings.
sentences.zh: 这为他们的调查结果增添了新的维度。

sentences.en: So it's possible that these girls, now women,
sentences.zh: 所以，这些女孩——现在已是女性——

sentences.en: in Florida who alleged that Jeffrey Epstein had done these things to them and who were kind of boxed out of this non-prosecution agreement,
sentences.zh: 在佛罗里达州指控杰弗里·爱泼斯坦对她们做了这些事，且在某种程度上被排除在那份不起诉协议之外，

sentences.en: that they may be drawn into this case and have their day in court here in New York.
sentences.zh: 她们可能会被卷入此案，并在纽约获得伸张正义的机会。

sentences.en: Possibly.
sentences.zh: 有可能。

sentences.en: We're going to have to wait and see,
sentences.zh: 我们还得拭目以待，

sentences.en: given this sort of tricky dynamic between having somebody in the Justice Department in New York signing off on a new case that had been sort of closed and done by somebody in the Justice Department in Miami.
sentences.zh: 考虑到这种微妙的动态：司法部在纽约的人员要签署一份新案件，而该案此前已被司法部在迈阿密的人员草草结案。

sentences.en: It seems like the U.S.
sentences.zh: 看起来美国

sentences.en: Attorney in New York is saying something about how the case was handled in Florida.
sentences.zh: 纽约联邦检察官似乎在暗示佛罗里达州处理此案的方式有问题。

sentences.en: It sounded like the U.S.
sentences.zh: 听起来美国

sentences.en: Attorney in New York was implying that this case maybe wasn't handled so well the first time around,
sentences.zh: 纽约联邦检察官是在暗示，这起案件第一次处理得并不好，

sentences.en: either by his predecessors in New York or by his colleagues in Florida, and that now he has another shot.
sentences.zh: 无论是由于他在纽约的前任，还是他在佛罗里达州的同事，而现在他有了另一次机会。

sentences.en: They get a do-over here, and they plan to take it.
sentences.zh: 他们在这里获得了重审机会，并且打算抓住它。

sentences.en: And they have a chance to make things right for all these victims after all these years.
sentences.zh: 他们有机会在多年后为所有这些受害者伸张正义。

sentences.en: Patty, you've been covering this case as a reporter in Florida for years.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂，作为佛罗里达州的记者，你多年来一直跟踪报道此案。

sentences.en: To me, it's an illustration of how society has changed in the time since this case first came up.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这说明了自此案首次出现以来，社会发生了怎样的变化。

sentences.en: And now, I think between the Me Too movement that has exposed some very powerful men and their behavior towards women,
sentences.zh: 现在，我认为“我也是”运动曝光了一些非常有权势的男性及其对待女性的行为，

sentences.en: I think some of society's impatience now with perhaps wealthy people having a bigger say in the criminal justice system than people who don't have money.
sentences.zh: 我认为社会现在对富人在刑事司法系统中比没钱的人拥有更大话语权感到不满。

sentences.en: And it's also just interesting that the charge Epstein faced was for soliciting prostitution.
sentences.zh: 还有一点很有趣，爱泼斯坦当时面临的指控是招揽卖淫。

sentences.en: I'm so struck by the fact that the resolution of that first Florida case was a prostitution charge,
sentences.zh: 令我震惊的是，佛罗里达州那起案件的最终结果竟然是一个卖淫指控，

sentences.en: which meant that prosecutors there essentially labeled a minor who was allegedly paid for sex by Jeffrey Epstein as a prostitute, not a victim.
sentences.zh: 这意味着那里的检察官本质上是将一个据称被杰弗里·爱泼斯坦付钱性侵的未成年人贴上了妓女的标签，而不是受害者。

sentences.en: Actually, the former police chief in Palm Beach, whose department first started investigating this,
sentences.zh: 事实上，棕榈滩的前警察局长，也就是最初开始调查此案的部门负责人，

sentences.en: has said that what he would really like to see here, in addition to an apology to the victims
sentences.zh: 曾表示他真正希望看到的是，除了向受害者道歉之外，

sentences.en: who did not get what he would consider timely justice, he would like to see lawmakers keep that from happening again.
sentences.zh: 那些没有得到他认为及时正义的受害者，他希望立法者能防止这种情况再次发生。

sentences.en: He would like to make it impossible for prosecutors to treat minors like prostitutes in future cases like this one to prevent what he considers was a miscarriage of justice.
sentences.zh: 他希望让检察官在未来类似的案件中无法将未成年人当作妓女对待，以防止他所认为的司法不公再次发生。

sentences.en: Patty, where is Jeffrey Epstein right now?
sentences.zh: 帕蒂，杰弗里·爱泼斯坦现在在哪里？

sentences.en: He is in jail in New York and not the kind of jail where you could leave every day to go to work like he was in Florida.
sentences.zh: 他在纽约的监狱里，而不是像在佛罗里达州那样，每天可以离开去上班的监狱。

sentences.en: And he faces the prospect of up to 45 years in prison if this case moves forward and he's found guilty.
sentences.zh: 如果此案推进且他被判有罪，他将面临最高45年的监禁。

sentences.en: Patty, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: On Monday, federal investigators said they had found hundreds of photographs of nude and partially nude young women and girls inside Jeffrey Epstein's New York home.
sentences.zh: 周一，联邦调查人员表示，他们在杰弗里·爱泼斯坦的纽约家中发现了数百张裸体和半裸年轻女性及女孩的照片。

sentences.en: After reviewing the photos, prosecutors said that Epstein, quote, is not reformed, he is not chastened, he is not repentant.
sentences.zh: 在审查了这些照片后，检察官表示，爱泼斯坦“没有改过自新，没有受到惩戒，也没有悔意”。

sentences.en: Rather, he is a continuing danger to the community.
sentences.zh: 相反，他继续对社区构成威胁。

sentences.en: Shortly after, Epstein pleaded not guilty in federal court.
sentences.zh: 此后不久，爱泼斯坦在联邦法院拒不认罪。

sentences.en: Later on Monday, Attorney General Bill Barr was asked about how Alex Acosta, the former U.S.
sentences.zh: 周一晚些时候，司法部长比尔·巴尔被问及亚历克斯·阿科斯塔——这位前佛罗里达州联邦检察官、现任总统劳工部长——是如何处理最初佛罗里达州爱泼斯坦案的。

sentences.en: attorney in Florida, and now the president's secretary of labor, had handled the original Epstein case in Florida.
sentences.zh: 巴尔拒绝置评。

sentences.en: Barr declined to comment.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: In a highly unusual move, the government lawyers defending the president's efforts to ask about citizenship on the 2020 census have left the case, apparently in proteSt.
sentences.zh: 在一项极不寻常的举动中，负责为总统在2020年人口普查中询问公民身份的努力进行辩护的政府律师退出了此案，显然是在抗议。

sentences.en: The lawyers had been asked to defend the question, despite a recent ruling by the Supreme Court that found that there was no legal basis for including the question.
sentences.zh: 尽管最高法院最近裁定将该问题纳入普查没有法律依据，但这些律师仍被要求为该问题辩护。

sentences.en: And, in Sudan, military leaders and protesters have reached an unexpected agreement to share power after the military carried out a deadly crackdown on the protesters.
sentences.zh: 此外，在苏丹，军方领导人和抗议者在军方对抗议者进行致命镇压后，意外达成了一项权力分享协议。

sentences.en: Under the agreement, an army general will run Sudan for nearly two years, followed by a civilian leader for the next year and a half.
sentences.zh: 根据协议，一名陆军将军将统治苏丹近两年，随后由一名文职领导人接管一年半。

sentences.en: The plan offers the possibility of an eventual transition to democracy after 30 years of dictatorship.
sentences.zh: 该计划为结束30年的独裁统治，最终向民主过渡提供了可能。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bavara.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴瓦拉。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线条件？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
